t: The Nebo Blueline Rechargeable LED Handheld Torch delivers bright, reliable lighting in a compact, durable design. Producing up to 450lm with a 43m beam, it features a COB work light and a focused top LED for versatile use on site or outdoors. The red COB mode provides clear visibility for signalling and roadside emergencies. Built with an aluminium body, magnetic base, and steel clip, it offers practical hands-free lighting and dependable performance in demanding conditions. Run time varies depending on selected light mode: Flashlight (250lm for 3 hours / 50lm for 21 hours), COB (450lm for 1.5 hours / 90lm for 12.5hrs), and Red (12lm for 15 hours / 6lm for 20 hours).
